cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this new series about Let's Build a Chatbot.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到新的系列：一起打造聊天機器人。

cues.en: So, this is all about, in AI, in C-sharp, we want to use the Microsoft Latent Framework
cues.zh: 這個系列屬於 AI in C#，我們會使用 Microsoft Agent Framework，

cues.en: to build a chatbot in various different ways.
cues.zh: 透過不同方式打造聊天機器人。

cues.en: But we're not just going to build very simple sample code.
cues.zh: 但不只是非常簡單的範例程式碼。

cues.en: We are actually going to build a real full-featured chatbot.
cues.zh: 我們要打造真正具備完整功能的聊天機器人。

cues.en: We are aiming for being as good as ChatGBT.
cues.zh: 目標是做到和 ChatGPT 一樣好。

cues.en: That will probably be difficult, but let's aim for it.
cues.zh: 可能不太容易，但就朝這個方向努力。

cues.en: We're going to build it in various frontends, Blazor, React, and so on.
cues.zh: 會使用不同前端，例如 Blazor、React 等等。

cues.en: And we're going to use Microsoft Latent Framework as the backend.
cues.zh: 後端則採用 Microsoft Agent Framework。

cues.en: That's the main goal.
cues.zh: 這是主要目標。

cues.en: But how do we actually build a real-life chatbot just like ChatGBT if we were to do that?
cues.zh: 如果真的要打造像 ChatGPT 一樣、可以實際使用的聊天機器人，該怎麼做？

cues.en: So, the journey of the series would be that we start with a baseline.
cues.zh: 這個系列會先從基本版本開始。

cues.en: What we're going to do is we are starting in Blazor Server, but slowly building up to more and more advanced ways and more real ways of doing things.
cues.zh: 首先使用 Blazor Server，再慢慢增加更進階、更貼近實務的做法。

cues.en: We're going to put in the default chat tools and conversations, but then we're going to pile on features as we go along.
cues.zh: 加入基本對話、工具與會話功能，再逐步堆疊更多功能。

cues.en: We're going to try to see if we can add user memory.
cues.zh: 例如嘗試加入使用者記憶。

cues.en: We're going to try and do more advanced tool recalling,
cues.zh: 也會加入更進階的工具呼叫，

cues.en: like MCP skills, have image generation be possible,
cues.zh: 例如 MCP、技能，以及圖像生成，

cues.en: PDF and image input, and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 還有 PDF 與圖片輸入等等。

cues.en: We're also going to put in additional frontends, as mentioned, so not only Blazor Server, but Blazor Wasm, React, and so on,
cues.zh: 如前面提到的，也會加入其他前端，不只有 Blazor Server，還有 Blazor WebAssembly、React 等，

cues.en: to see what is the differences, can we use ADUI for something, and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 看看有哪些差異，以及 AG-UI 等機制是否有幫助。

cues.en: We're going to look at security aspects of how can we make a login, how can we secure things and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 也會介紹安全議題，例如如何登入、如何保護系統。

cues.en: Not the main focus of this, but still, if we are to build something real, we, of course, need to secure it in some way.
cues.zh: 雖然不是主要重點，但既然要建立實際產品，當然需要某種安全機制。

cues.en: And finally, if we get to that point, again, these are the main focus areas, because security and deployment are more or less the same
cues.zh: 最後，如果進度順利，也會介紹部署。主要仍然是前面的功能，因為安全與部署大致和，

cues.en: across any website, any system, but we're going to try and make the deployment of the chatbot as well.
cues.zh: 其他網站、系統相同，不過還是會嘗試部署聊天機器人。

cues.en: We will focus on trying to do this as real-world as possible, trying to say, okay, if I were to build a chatbot in real life
cues.zh: 我們會盡量貼近實際開發：如果我真的要打造聊天機器人，

cues.en: and release it, this is what I would do for real, not just small demos and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 並發布給人使用，會如何實作，而不只是小型展示。

cues.en: And I'm trying to build as much reusable components so you can copy-paste parts of it into real-world applications yourself.
cues.zh: 也會盡可能建立可重複使用的元件，方便你複製到自己的實際應用程式。

cues.en: We're not going to really focus on the visuals.
cues.zh: 視覺設計不是重點。

cues.en: The visuals will be okay, but not pretty, so I'll probably use some coding agents in order to help with that.
cues.zh: 介面會堪用，但不會很漂亮，所以可能會請程式開發代理程式協助。

cues.en: And for back-end data, we're going to keep it light.
cues.zh: 後端資料則會保持簡單。

cues.en: We might set up a vector store behind the scenes just as a reference, but the data is not really the focus.
cues.zh: 也許會建立向量儲存區作為示範，但資料本身不是重點。

cues.en: It will more be the wiring up of the various different parts.
cues.zh: 重點是把各個部分串接起來。

cues.en: Here's just a small sneak preview of the first implementation, which will be a Blazor server baseline, where we are trying to make the default chat with an input
cues.zh: 先預覽第一個實作，也就是 Blazor Server 基本版。我們會建立基本對話介面，有輸入框，

cues.en: and a conversation back and forward with chat bottles as we normally do, but also we end up with a lot of options that you can turn on and off
cues.zh: 以及平常看到的對話泡泡，讓雙方來回交談。另外也有許多選項，可以開啟或關閉，

cues.en: to see where different things are.
cues.zh: 觀察各功能的差異。

cues.en: We're going to make a conversation history over here so you can switch between the different ones, switch to a new chat.
cues.zh: 旁邊會建立對話歷史，可以切換不同對話，或開始新對話。

cues.en: This is just a baseline. Later on, we will put even more into it.
cues.zh: 這只是基本版，之後會繼續加入功能。

cues.en: And as you can see, I'm building it as components.
cues.zh: 可以看到，我把介面拆成元件。

cues.en: So, for example, in Blazor, if you want a sidebar, it will be possible.
cues.zh: 例如在 Blazor 中，如果想顯示側邊欄，也可以做到。

cues.en: Again, not pretty, but okay.
cues.zh: 同樣地，不算漂亮，但堪用。

cues.en: So that was the intro.
cues.zh: 以上就是這個系列的介紹。

cues.en: We're going to do a little intro more about the repo and the solution in general before we jump into Blazor.
cues.zh: 在進入 Blazor 實作之前，會再簡單介紹儲存庫與整體方案結構。

cues.en: But see you in the next one.
cues.zh: 下一支影片見。
